concepts.title: Cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_p$-extension
concepts.blurb: The unique $\mathbb{Z}_p$-extension of $\mathbb{Q}$ sits inside $\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_{p^\infty})$: take the fixed field $\mathbb{Q}_\infty$ of the torsion part of $\Gal(\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_{p^\infty})/\mathbb{Q})$, so $\Gal(\mathbb{Q}_\infty/\mathbb{Q})\cong\mathbb{Z}_p$. Iwasawa attached three invariants $\mu,\lambda,\nu$ to any $\mathbb{Z}_p$-tower.

concepts.title: Iwasawa algebra $\Lambda$
concepts.blurb: Pick a topological generator $\gamma\in\Gamma\cong\mathbb{Z}_p$. The completed group ring $\mathbb{Z}_p[[\Gamma]]=\varprojlim\mathbb{Z}_p[\Gamma/\Gamma^{p^n}]$ becomes the formal power series ring $\Lambda=\mathbb{Z}_p[[T]]$ via $\gamma\mapsto 1+T$. Finitely-generated $\Lambda$-modules satisfy a structure theorem up to pseudo-isomorphism.

concepts.title: Class groups along the tower
concepts.blurb: Let $A_n$ be the $p$-part of the ideal class group of the $n$-th layer $K_n$. The inverse limit $X_\infty=\varprojlim A_n$ is a finitely generated torsion $\Lambda$-module, and Iwasawa's growth formula says $|A_n|=p^{\mu p^n+\lambda n+\nu}$ for $n\gg 0$. Ferrero–Washington (1979): $\mu=0$ for the cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_p$-extension of any abelian number field.

concepts.title: Kubota–Leopoldt $p$-adic $L$-function
concepts.blurb: For each non-trivial even Dirichlet character $\chi$ there is a continuous $L_p(s,\chi)\colon\mathbb{Z}_p\to\mathbb{C}_p$ interpolating the special values $L_p(1-n,\chi)=(1-\chi\omega^{-n}(p)p^{n-1})\,L(1-n,\chi\omega^{-n})$ at non-positive integers. Equivalently, an element $L_p(\chi,T)\in\Lambda\otimes\mathbb{Q}_p$ realising the interpolation through $\Gamma$-characters.

concepts.title: Iwasawa main conjecture
concepts.blurb: Mazur–Wiles (1984) proved that for an even character $\chi$ of $\Gal(\mathbb{Q}(\mu_{p^\infty})/\mathbb{Q})$, the characteristic ideal of the $\chi$-eigenspace $X_\infty(\chi^{-1}\omega)$ equals the ideal generated by the Kubota–Leopoldt $L_p(\chi,T)$ in $\Lambda$. Wiles (1990) extended this to totally real fields; the conjecture organises every refined class-number formula in one identity.

concepts.title: Elliptic Iwasawa theory and BSD
concepts.blurb: For an elliptic curve $E/\mathbb{Q}$ with good ordinary reduction at $p$, the Pontryagin dual $\mathrm{Sel}_{p^\infty}(E/\mathbb{Q}_\infty)^\vee$ is a finitely generated torsion $\Lambda$-module whose characteristic ideal conjecturally equals $(L_p(E,T))$. Coates–Wiles (CM case, 1977), Kato (one divisibility), and Skinner–Urban (the other divisibility) yield $p$-part BSD for many curves of analytic rank $\le 1$.
